sourceGoal: YNX Chain Founder-Grade Coordinated Final Goal Prompts, product 20

entries.requirement: Protect existing and new work with a remote push or a verified recovery bundle.
entries.blockedBy: GitHub upstream returned 502 or an empty reply for three bounded push attempts
entries.nextAction: Retry a normal push after upstream recovery; never force-push or reset over newer work.

entries.requirement: Files, folders, search, metadata, download, range, preview, checksum, versions, restore, trash and audit.
entries.nextAction: Add remote object-store and CDN/range proof.

entries.requirement: Multipart upload, restart resume, pause as client stop/resume, cancel and presigned direct upload.
entries.nextAction: Provision an S3-compatible provider and verify provider-native multipart/direct upload.

entries.requirement: File/folder/version ACL, expiring scoped links, permission checks and revoke with no public-by-default state.
entries.nextAction: Verify central Wallet staging and multi-device revoke.

entries.requirement: Offline queue, sync, conflict detection and user-controlled conflict resolution.
entries.nextAction: Run a two-device staging conflict and recovery drill.

entries.requirement: Quota, usage, trash, retention, legal-hold boundary, portable export and product-scoped delete.
entries.nextAction: Complete provider replica, backup sanitization and native object-lock proof.

entries.requirement: Versioned backup, hash-verified restore, rollback migration, restart recovery and cross-region drill.
entries.blockedBy: Cross-region provider and deployment authority are not provisioned
entries.nextAction: Run the prepared restore drill against provisioned independent regions.

entries.requirement: Real S3-compatible or YNX-managed object storage with truthful SLA, versioning, encryption, residency, egress, failure and exit contract.
entries.blockedBy: Provider agreement, endpoint, credential reference, KMS and regions
entries.nextAction: Use the operator input request and keep durability claims bounded until remote proof exists.

entries.requirement: Stateless API, worker queue, metadata sharding, backpressure, rate limit, region placement and million-object candidate benchmark.
entries.nextAction: Add concurrent persisted, sharded and remote benchmarks plus queue/worker implementation.

entries.requirement: Content-addressed storage and safe deduplication.
entries.nextAction: Design a product-isolated digest index with race, ACL and erasure tests.

entries.requirement: Hot, cold and archive lifecycle plus CDN and replication or erasure-coding candidate.
entries.blockedBy: Final proof depends on provider capabilities, but provider-neutral lifecycle contracts remain autonomous work
entries.nextAction: Define lifecycle and portability contracts before provider activation.

entries.requirement: TLS, at-rest encryption, optional client-side encryption candidate, malware-scan boundary and least-privilege access.
entries.blockedBy: Remote TLS, KMS and scanner proof require provider/deployment input
entries.nextAction: Implement and test the client-side encryption candidate independently; verify KMS/scanner after provisioning.

entries.requirement: Canonical Wallet/Product Session, exact scopes, replay/tamper/expiry/revoke and fail-closed central verification.
entries.nextAction: Submit the frozen contract to Wallet/Auth and Integration owners for staging acceptance.

entries.requirement: Central Wallet registration and shared Testnet acceptance.
entries.blockedBy: Wallet/Auth owner review and Integration owner acceptance
entries.nextAction: Keep registrations disabled and fail closed until accepted.

entries.requirement: AI may access only an explicitly selected object and version with consent, audit and honest provider failure.
entries.nextAction: Run configured AI Gateway staging proof.

entries.requirement: Quant, Developer, AI, media and Docs artifacts carry hash, version, owner, product, ACL, retention and revoke state.
entries.nextAction: Run a real Quant artifact staging consumer flow.

entries.requirement: Meter storage, egress, scan, compute, backup and replication with transparent provider cost, fee, charge and refund boundaries.
entries.blockedBy: Provider invoices and approved pricing are required for final reconciliation
entries.nextAction: Add attributable backup/replication meters and provider reconciliation.

entries.requirement: Web/PWA with file list/grid, preview, inspector, share, versions, usage, upload queue, 12 locales, Arabic RTL, accessibility, dark/light and 390px support.
entries.nextAction: Run the hosted browser and network-failure matrix.

entries.requirement: Android and iOS clients with install, cold start, callback, RTL, dark mode and large text evidence.
entries.blockedBy: Current iOS simulator CI evidence is absent; production signing and stores require external accounts/assets
entries.nextAction: Capture iOS simulator CI and rebuild the Android preview from the current commit.

entries.requirement: Versioned API and dependency-free JavaScript/TypeScript SDK with bounded idempotent retry and error correlation.
entries.nextAction: Publish an immutable package and run a staging consumer proof.

entries.requirement: Least-privilege Docker/Server delivery with bounded context, non-root execution, read-only root, persistent state and liveness.
entries.blockedBy: Local Docker daemon was unavailable; exact CI build and cold-start run is pending
entries.nextAction: Obtain a green Cloud security workflow run before marking testedLocal.

entries.requirement: Structured logs, request/error/audit IDs, liveness, authenticated readiness, metrics, traces, alerts and recovery runbook.
entries.nextAction: Add provider child spans, distributed export and hosted dashboard/paging evidence.

entries.requirement: Threat model, security boundaries, SBOM, notices, deterministic security gate, provenance and container/artifact scan evidence.
entries.blockedBy: Container scan requires a successfully built image; external review is not available
entries.nextAction: Add CI image scanning and retain external audit as a separate proof class.

entries.requirement: Staging/public service, hosted artifacts, support/privacy/security/status paths, public evidence and /cloud micro-site.
entries.blockedBy: DNS, deployment authority, central acceptance, provider and artifact hosting
entries.nextAction: Deploy only after central/provider gates and run remote smoke with immutable evidence.

entries.requirement: Real Object Storage, multipart/resume, share/revoke, version/restore, offline conflict, quota, provider failure, backup/restore, Quant artifact, AI selected-file and export/delete end-to-end proof.
entries.blockedBy: Central integration, provisioned object storage and public deployment are required for final remote proof
entries.nextAction: Continue autonomous storage lifecycle and scale gaps, then execute the shared Testnet flow.
